color.name: background
color.usage: Theme: page background behind every panel (shadcn `background`).

color.name: foreground
color.usage: Theme: default text and icons (shadcn `foreground`).

color.name: card
color.usage: Theme: cards, panels, inputs and the workspace sheet (shadcn `card`).

color.name: card-foreground
color.usage: Theme: text on cards.

color.name: popover
color.usage: Theme: menus, popovers, select lists, command palette, hover cards, dialogs.

color.name: popover-foreground
color.usage: Theme: text on popovers.

color.name: primary
color.usage: Theme: the brand colour. Primary buttons, checked boxes, switches, selected chips and days, progress, active marks.

color.name: primary-foreground
color.usage: Theme: text and icons on `primary`.

color.name: primary-hover
color.usage: Theme: `primary` under the pointer.

color.name: secondary
color.usage: Theme: secondary actions. Soft buttons and icon buttons, neutral chips and badges.

color.name: secondary-foreground
color.usage: Theme: text on `secondary`.

color.name: muted
color.usage: Theme: quiet fills. Tracks of segmented controls, tabs and progress, search fields, code, placeholders.

color.name: muted-foreground
color.usage: Theme: secondary text, captions, metadata.

color.name: accent
color.usage: Theme: highlight under the pointer or keyboard. Menu items, list rows, options, ghost buttons, nav items.

color.name: accent-foreground
color.usage: Theme: text on `accent`.

color.name: destructive
color.usage: Theme: destructive actions and errors. Danger buttons, error text and icons.

color.name: destructive-foreground
color.usage: Theme: text on solid `destructive`.

color.name: border
color.usage: Theme: hairlines and dividers between surfaces.

color.name: input
color.usage: Theme: borders of fields, checkboxes and radios, and strong lines.

color.name: ring
color.usage: Theme: keyboard focus rings.

color.name: chart-1
color.usage: Theme: chart series 1 (sky series).

color.name: chart-2
color.usage: Theme: chart series 2 (mint series).

color.name: chart-3
color.usage: Theme: chart series 3 (butter series).

color.name: chart-4
color.usage: Theme: chart series 4 (lilac series).

color.name: chart-5
color.usage: Theme: chart series 5 (blush series).

color.name: sidebar
color.usage: Theme: Sidebar background.

color.name: sidebar-foreground
color.usage: Theme: Sidebar text.

color.name: sidebar-primary
color.usage: Theme: Sidebar emphasis (current item mark, badges).

color.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
color.usage: Theme: text on `sidebar-primary`.

color.name: sidebar-accent
color.usage: Theme: Sidebar item under the pointer and the current item.

color.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
color.usage: Theme: text on `sidebar-accent`.

color.name: sidebar-border
color.usage: Theme: Sidebar edges and dividers.

color.name: sidebar-ring
color.usage: Theme: focus rings inside the Sidebar.

color.name: canvas
color.usage: Page background behind every panel and card.

color.name: surface
color.usage: Cards, panels, inputs and the main workspace sheet.

color.name: surface-sunken
color.usage: Search fields, segmented-tab tracks, quiet chips and icon-button fills on `surface`.

color.name: frame
color.usage: The dark app frame: top bar, dock and the outer shell around the workspace.

color.name: on-frame
color.usage: Text and icons on `frame`.

color.name: on-frame-muted
color.usage: Secondary text and idle nav icons on `frame` (7:1+).

color.name: ink
color.usage: Headings, numbers and body copy on `surface`, `canvas`, `surface-sunken` and every tint.

color.name: ink-muted
color.usage: Descriptions, meta lines and labels on `surface` and `canvas` (4.5:1+ in both themes).

color.name: ink-subtle
color.usage: Placeholders, disabled text and the quietest meta; 4.5:1 on surface and surface-sunken in both themes, still clearly lighter than ink-muted.

color.name: line
color.usage: Hairline dividers and table rules; decorative, never the only boundary of a control.

color.name: line-strong
color.usage: Dashed placeholder tiles and input borders (3:1 on `surface`).

color.name: sky
color.usage: Info tint: stat tiles, event cards, the 'scheduled' state. Text on it is `ink`.

color.name: sky-ink
color.usage: Icons and labels on `sky` or as an icon colour on `surface`.

color.name: mint
color.usage: Success tint: published/live states, positive stat tiles. Text on it is `ink`.

color.name: mint-ink
color.usage: Icons and labels on `mint`; success marks on `surface`.

color.name: lilac
color.usage: Highlight tint: the one featured card in a grid, lesson events. Text on it is `ink`.

color.name: lilac-ink
color.usage: Icons and labels on `lilac`.

color.name: butter
color.usage: Money and attention tint: revenue tiles, task events, pending states. Text on it is `ink`.

color.name: butter-ink
color.usage: Icons and labels on `butter`.

color.name: blush
color.usage: Danger and support tint: errors, tickets, destructive confirms. Text on it is `ink`.

color.name: blush-ink
color.usage: Icons and labels on `blush`; destructive text on `surface`.

color.name: focus
color.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid outline, 1px offset, on every interactive element.

color.name: count
color.usage: Count pills on nav items and tabs (unread, open approvals).

color.name: on-count
color.usage: Text on `count`.

color.name: on-frame-success
color.usage: Success marks on frame: the brand dot, ok lines in logs.

color.name: on-frame-danger
color.usage: Error lines in logs and other danger marks on frame.

color.name: scrim
color.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs, sheets and the command palette.

color.name: scrim-strong
color.usage: Backdrop behind modals and the command palette.

color.name: glass
color.usage: Glass surfaces: panels, cards, docks and map overlays floating over content. Opaque enough that body text stays at 4.5:1 or more over any backdrop.

color.name: glass-strong
color.usage: Glass for text-heavy floating layers: menus, popovers, dialogs, drawers.

color.name: glass-control
color.usage: Inputs, secondary buttons and chips on glass (replaces surface inside a glass surface).

color.name: glass-well
color.usage: Tab tracks, badges, search fields and nested cards on glass (replaces surface-sunken).

color.name: glass-hover
color.usage: Hover and selection highlight on glass (replaces accent).

color.name: glass-border
color.usage: The hairline edge of a glass surface.

color.name: glass-highlight
color.usage: Light catching the top edge of a glass surface.

color.name: glass-sheen
color.usage: Pro glass is flat: no sheen.

color.name: ambient-base
color.usage: Ground of the Ambient background, under the colour fields.

color.name: ambient-1
color.usage: First colour field of the Ambient gradient (a faint aurora in Pro).

color.name: ambient-2
color.usage: Second colour field of the Ambient gradient.

color.name: ambient-3
color.usage: Third colour field of the Ambient gradient.

color.name: ambient-4
color.usage: Fourth colour field of the Ambient gradient.

color.name: ambient-scrim
color.usage: Softens a photo or video under glass so the page keeps its calm.

color.name: bg-000
color.usage: Canvas: app background, behind hairline grids, inputs on surfaces.

color.name: bg-100
color.usage: Surface: every grid cell, panel, table, sidebar, dialog.

color.name: bg-200
color.usage: Raised: row and button hover, kbd keys, skeletons, code blocks.

color.name: bg-300
color.usage: Selected: active nav item, selected row, pressed segment, open menu trigger.

color.name: fg-100
color.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface (bg-000 to bg-300).

color.name: fg-200
color.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, table cells that are not the row's key, inactive nav items. On bg-000 to bg-300.

color.name: fg-300
color.usage: Muted text: meta, timestamps, column headers, eyebrows. On bg-000 to bg-300.

color.name: fg-400
color.usage: Disabled text and placeholders only. Below 4.5:1 by design; never for information.

color.name: line-100
color.usage: Faint hairline: row separators inside tables and lists, background grid.

color.name: line-200
color.usage: Hairline: the structural 1px grid between cells, panel and overlay borders, table header rule. Decorative, not a control boundary.

color.name: line-300
color.usage: Control border (3:1 on bg-000, bg-100, bg-200): inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons, crosshair marks.

color.name: chart-grid
color.usage: Chart gridlines.

color.name: chart-sky
color.usage: Chart series tinted sky: a step of the monochrome ramp (charts carry no decorative colour).

color.name: chart-mint
color.usage: Chart series tinted mint: a step of the monochrome ramp (charts carry no decorative colour).

color.name: chart-lilac
color.usage: Chart series tinted lilac: a step of the monochrome ramp (charts carry no decorative colour).

color.name: chart-butter
color.usage: Chart series tinted butter: a step of the monochrome ramp (charts carry no decorative colour).

color.name: chart-blush
color.usage: Chart series tinted blush: a step of the monochrome ramp (charts carry no decorative colour).

color.name: ok
color.usage: Success / done / healthy: text and status shapes (circle). On bg-000 to bg-300.

color.name: ok-bg
color.usage: Tint behind ok badges, banners and diff additions.

color.name: info
color.usage: Running / in progress / neutral notices. Shape: pulsing dot.

color.name: info-bg
color.usage: Tint behind info badges and banners.

color.name: warn
color.usage: Warning: budget at 80 %, expiring domains, degraded checks. Shape: triangle.

color.name: warn-bg
color.usage: Tint behind warning badges and banners.

color.name: danger
color.usage: Error, failed run, destructive actions, budget stop. Shape: square.

color.name: danger-bg
color.usage: Tint behind error badges, banners, diff removals.

color.name: signal
color.usage: Needs a human: approval waiting, beacons, the approval count. Shape: diamond. The only hue that may draw the eye unprompted.

color.name: signal-bg
color.usage: Tint behind approval cards' header and signal badges.

color.name: idle
color.usage: Status idle: ready, inactive (ring). Alias of `ink-muted`.

color.name: diff-add
color.usage: Added lines in override diffs.

color.name: diff-add-bg
color.usage: Fill of added lines. Alias of `mint`.

color.name: diff-del
color.usage: Removed lines in override diffs.

color.name: diff-del-bg
color.usage: Fill of removed lines. Alias of `blush`.

color.name: paper
color.usage: Document previews (invoices, PDFs): paper is white in both themes.

color.name: paper-ink
color.usage: Text on paper.

color.name: frame-hover
color.usage: Hover fill on the dark frame (top bar, dock, code blocks). Same in both themes.

color.name: frame-active
color.usage: Active or selected fill on the dark frame. Same in both themes.

color.name: frame-strong
color.usage: Strong fill or divider on the dark frame. Same in both themes.

color.name: on-frame-strong
color.usage: Highlighted text on the frame (log highlights). Same in both themes.

color.name: on-frame-warn
color.usage: Warnings and numbers in logs and code on the frame. Same in both themes.

color.name: on-frame-signal
color.usage: Keywords in code on the frame. Same in both themes.

color.name: ink-hover
color.usage: Hover fill on tinted surfaces such as alerts. Same in both themes.

color.name: hairline
color.usage: Thin outline around swatches and colour wells. Same in both themes.

color.name: media-scrim
color.usage: Labels and counters on top of photos. Same in both themes.

color.name: media-ink
color.usage: Text and lines on top of photos. Same in both themes.

color.name: media-shadow
color.usage: Shadow behind lines drawn on photos. Same in both themes.

color.name: lightbox
color.usage: Full-screen image viewer background. Same in both themes.

color.name: lightbox-ink
color.usage: Captions in the image viewer. Same in both themes.

color.name: paper-muted
color.usage: Secondary text on paper (4.5:1 on white).

color.name: paper-subtle
color.usage: Small print on `paper`. Same in both themes.

color.name: serp-ink
color.usage: Search ad preview: text. Same in both themes.

color.name: serp-muted
color.usage: Search ad preview: description and URL. Same in both themes.

color.name: serp-link
color.usage: Search ad preview: headline link. Same in both themes.

color.name: serp-chip
color.usage: Search ad preview: favicon chip. Same in both themes.

shadow.name: shadow-card
shadow.usage: Resting cards. Pro: none, hairlines divide.

shadow.name: shadow-float
shadow.usage: Floating layers: dock, toasts, menus and dialogs.

shadow.name: shadow-overlay
shadow.usage: Only floating layers: menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts, command palette. Always paired with a line-200 border.

component.name: button-radius
component.usage: Corners of buttons (Button, IconButton). One knob for a theme's button shape.

component.name: panel-bg
component.usage: Background of a panel: a cell of the hairline grid, a section, a side column.

component.name: panel-border
component.usage: Border colour of a panel standing on its own; transparent where panels float.

component.name: panel-radius
component.usage: Corners of a panel. Pro: square cells of the hairline grid.

component.name: panel-shadow
component.usage: Resting shadow of a panel. Pro: none, the hairlines divide.

component.name: panel-gap
component.usage: Gap between panels in a grid: the hairline in Pro, air between cards in Halo.

component.name: glass-filter
component.usage: backdrop-filter of glass surfaces: blur, colour lift and a nudge towards the theme's side.

component.name: glass-tint
component.usage: How strongly a tint (StatTile, tinted Card) colours the glass it sits on.

font.name: font-mono
font.value: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
font.usage: Numbers, IDs, addresses, code, timestamps and eyebrows.

type.name: display
type.usage: One per screen at most: module title on overview pages, login.

type.name: number-xl
type.usage: The value in a stat cell (same as numeric).

type.name: h2
type.usage: Section and panel titles (same as heading).

type.name: body
type.usage: Running text in comfortable density, chat messages, mail bodies.

type.name: body-long
type.usage: Reading text: mail bodies, chat messages.

type.name: body-sm
type.usage: Default UI text in compact density: tables, lists, nav, controls.

type.name: label
type.usage: Form labels, button text in small buttons, badge text.

type.name: small
type.usage: Meta lines, hints and timestamps (same as caption).

type.name: caption
type.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and table headers (same as eyebrow).

type.name: micro
type.usage: Counts inside nav dots and tiny badges.

type.name: code
type.usage: Logs, DNS records, IDs and code (same as mono).

type.name: heading
type.usage: Panel and dialog titles, mail subject in the reader.

type.name: title
type.usage: Card and section titles, agent names, table row keys.

type.name: eyebrow
type.usage: Uppercase section labels, table column headers, grid cell labels. Uppercase via CSS.

type.name: mono
type.usage: Logs, tool calls, IDs, DNS values, email addresses in lists.

type.name: mono-sm
type.usage: Timestamps, amounts in dense tables, shortcuts.

type.name: numeric
type.usage: KPI values in stat cells. Always tabular figures.

space.name: space-1
space.usage: Gap inside badges and kbd groups.

space.name: space-2
space.usage: Gap between icon and label, between buttons in a group.

space.name: space-3
space.usage: Compact horizontal cell and control padding.

space.name: space-4
space.usage: Grid cell padding, comfortable control padding, page gutter on mobile.

space.name: space-6
space.usage: Cell padding on overview grids; background-grid pitch.

space.name: space-8
space.usage: Gap between stacked sections inside a panel.

space.name: space-10
space.usage: Outer margin of the app frame on large screens.

radius.name: radius
radius.usage: Theme: the base corner radius; Pro is square at 2px, larger values round cards and menus too (shadcn `radius`).

radius.name: radius-sm
radius.usage: Inputs inside cells, row hovers, small tiles.

radius.name: radius-md
radius.usage: Stat cells, event cards, menus: square in Pro.

radius.name: radius-lg
radius.usage: Cards and panels: square cells of the hairline grid.

radius.name: radius-xl
radius.usage: The workspace sheet and app frame: square in Pro.

radius.name: radius-pill
radius.usage: Buttons, chips, badges, tabs and inputs: 2px in Pro.

radius.name: radius-0
radius.usage: Default for everything structural: cells, panels, tables, dialogs, sheets, cards.

radius.name: radius-1
radius.usage: Controls: buttons, inputs, badges, kbd, switches, tooltips.

radius.name: radius-full
radius.usage: Only status dots and radio buttons.

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.usage: Press, hover colour changes, chip toggles.

motion.name: dur-base
motion.usage: Tab indicator slide, menu open, card lift.

motion.name: dur-enter
motion.usage: Entrances: short and quiet in Pro.

motion.name: dur-slow
motion.usage: Count-ups, chart draw-ins and progress fills: short in Pro.

motion.name: dur-exit
motion.usage: Overlays leaving: menus, popovers, dialogs, drawers, toasts.

motion.name: motion-time
motion.usage: Multiplier for choreography delays (when the dock, side panels and chart data come in).

motion.name: motion-travel
motion.usage: Multiplier for how far things travel when they come in.

motion.name: motion-blur
motion.usage: Blur things come out of as they rise (expressive Halo only).

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.usage: No overshoot in Pro: the standard curve.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.usage: Things moving between two resting places.

size.name: control-md
size.usage: Default control height (follows density in components).

size.name: row-dense
size.usage: Row height for tables, lists and nav items in compact density.

size.name: control-dense
size.usage: Button and input height in compact density.

size.name: control-comfy
size.usage: Button and input height in comfortable density.

size.name: icon-sm
size.usage: Icons inside badges and dense table cells.

size.name: icon-lg
size.usage: Icons in navigation: same as icon-md in Pro.

size.name: line-width
size.usage: Every border and grid line (Pro calls it hairline).
